# Pinned upstream commits

## anthropics/jacobian-lens

```
repository: https://github.com/anthropics/jacobian-lens
commit:     581d398613e5602a5af361e1c34d3a92ea82ba8e
date:       2026-07-02 09:07:51 +0000
subject:    Initial release
licence:    see upstream LICENSE; recorded in compliance/LICENCES.md
```

**Provenance of this pin.** Phase 0 notebooks cloned with
`git clone -q --depth 1`, which records no commit and pins nothing — it takes
whatever HEAD was on the day. The exact commit was therefore not captured at run
time.

It is nonetheless known with certainty, because the upstream repository contained
exactly one commit as of 2026-08-05. Every Phase 0 clone necessarily obtained
`581d398`. Verified by cloning the full history on 2026-08-05:

```
$ git log --format="%H %ci %s"
581d398613e5602a5af361e1c34d3a92ea82ba8e 2026-07-02 09:07:51 +0000 Initial release
```

This is a reconstruction, not a contemporaneous record. It is reliable here only
because the history is a single commit. **Do not rely on the same argument for
Phase 1 onward** — if upstream gains commits, an unpinned clone becomes genuinely
ambiguous.

## Required change for Phase 1 onward

Replace every unpinned clone with an explicit checkout:

```bash
git clone -q https://github.com/anthropics/jacobian-lens.git
cd jacobian-lens
git checkout 581d398613e5602a5af361e1c34d3a92ea82ba8e
```

`--depth 1` and `git checkout <hash>` do not combine cleanly. Drop `--depth 1`;
the repository is small.
